tagline: Global custodian and asset manager serving institutional clients worldwide
hero_kpi_rationale: This KPI is the Hero because it represents the company's core business, generates the majority of its fee revenue, and is a key indicator of its leadership position in asset custody and administration services.
company_description: The Bank of New York Mellon Corporation provides a range of financial products and services in the United States and internationally. It operates through Securities Services, Market and Wealth Services, Investment and Wealth Management, and Other segments. The Securities Services segment offers custody, trust and depositary, accounting, exchange-traded funds, middle-office solutions, transfer agency, services for private equity and real estate funds, foreign exchange, securities lending, liquidity/lending services, and data analytics. This segment also provides trustee, paying agency, fiduciary, escrow and other financial, issuer, and support services for brokers and investors. The Market and Wealth Services segment offers clearing and custody, investment, wealth and retirement solutions, technology and enterprise data management, trading, and prime brokerage services. This segment also provides integrated cash management solutions, including payments, foreign exchange, liquidity management, receivables processing, payables management, and trade finance, as well as U.S. government and global clearing, and tri-party services. risks.title: Cybersecurity and data protection risks
risks.summary: The company is exposed to cybersecurity attacks and data breaches that could result in significant financial losses and damage its reputation.
risks.score_rationale: The document explicitly mentions the 'Cybersecurity' section in Item 1C, indicating strategic importance. For a company managing $59.3 trillion in assets, cybersecurity risks are inherently high. This risk is stable compared to prior years. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Real estate and property cost management risks
risks.summary: Managing real estate assets, including costs related to optimizing 8.3 million square feet of global space, can have a significant impact on operating margins.
risks.score_rationale: Item 2 details property management and notes that costs related to reducing or occupying new space may be material to operating results. However, this risk is secondary compared to major operational and regulatory risks. The risk is stable. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Litigation and legal proceedings risks
risks.summary: The company may face legal proceedings related to its financial services operations that could lead to significant expenses.
risks.score_rationale: Item 3 refers to potential litigation documented in Note 21. For a financial services firm of this scale, litigation is inherent but managed through appropriate accounting provisions. The risk is stable. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Financial markets and volatility risks
risks.summary: Fluctuations in financial markets directly affect asset volumes under management and associated fee revenues.
risks.score_rationale: Item 7A addresses market risk disclosures. As a major player in custody and asset management, BNY is exposed to market volatility and fluctuations in fee income. The risk is stable. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Regulatory compliance risks
risks.summary: Changes in regulations governing global financial services may impose significant operational, technological, and financial constraints.
risks.score_rationale: As a global financial institution operating across multiple jurisdictions (U.S., EMEA, APAC), BNY is subject to a complex and evolving regulatory environment including Dodd-Frank, MiFID II, GDPR, and local banking regulations. Complying with these requirements is costly and a permanent feature of the operating model. The risk is stable. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Technology and innovation dependency risks
risks.summary: Failure to keep pace with technological innovation (cloud, AI, blockchain) or maintain reliability of critical systems could harm competitiveness and operations.
risks.score_rationale: As a technology-based financial services platform, the ability to innovate in cloud, fintech, blockchain, and data processing is critical to maintaining competitiveness and servicing $59.3 trillion in assets. Technological obsolescence represents an existential risk. The risk is stable. (default score, to be refined)
